loader_contract.lag_rule: MEASURED_BOUND_LAG_3D: every feature read is restricted to metrics rows with metrics_date <= decision_date - 3 calendar days
loader_contract.hole_rule: feature windows compute over available staged rows only; more than 10% missing metrics-day cells in a symbol's lookback window refuses that symbol's decision (refusal registry); a refused decision never becomes a fill and never synthesizes data
loader_contract.day_cell_integrity: exactly 288 rows, 288 unique create_time labels, full 00:00..23:55 grid, sorted by create_time, finite positive authorized fields; violations refuse the cell (fail closed)
loader_contract.label_semantics: start-of-period: labeled T carries the stock snapshot at T+5min and the taker flow window [T, T+5min); the daily aggregate consumes each label of its own metrics_date exactly once (no boundary double-count)
